cards.lore: The layout anarchist who sees through the Kayfabe. He's here to ruin Big Tech's meticulously curated PR with a sloppy bucket of watercolour ink.
cards.power: Narrative Sabotage. Dispels techno-scenic illusions in a 5-mile radius.

cards.lore: The digital panopticon disguised as a convenience utopia. You aren't the customer; your brain chemistry is the product.
cards.power: Extracts 6 hours and 58 minutes of lifespan daily from 86% of global players.

cards.lore: Irrefutably the most successful voluntary tracking bug in human history. You pay a premium to carry your own prison warden.
cards.power: Infiltrates the user's pocket. Automatically uploads your soul to the Cloud.

cards.lore: Over 8.92 billion captive animals staring into glowing rectangles, entirely cut off from the analog mud of reality.
cards.power: Triggers infinite scroll doom loop. Disables critical thinking.

cards.lore: The physical manifestation of toxic screen radiation combined with bacterial Petri dishes held willingly to the face.
cards.power: Reduces Charisma by 10. Induces permanent Wrist Shame.

cards.lore: Bow down to your new God; your spine will calcify and warp to match your unquestioning obedience.
cards.power: Forces submission posture. Cripples all melee attention.

cards.lore: The ghost of a notification haunting your pocket. Technophantoms call each other, a single system-psyche silently blinking for 99.1% of citizens.
cards.power: Induces phantom notifications. Costs 3 Sanity points per turn.

cards.lore: It's not a quirky habit; it's an epidemic sickness. The platforms are a distraction dictatorship destroying cognitive capacity.
cards.power: Unlocks full brain rot. Ideas are incredibly slow and painful.

cards.lore: The engineered terror of being disconnected from a digital world that fundamentally does not care about you.
cards.power: Forces the player to check their screen every 4 seconds.

cards.lore: The panic of the blinking dots. Will they reply? Do they hate me? The social contract, weaponized into psychological torture.
cards.power: Paralyzes communication. Stuns target for 3 consecutive turns.

cards.lore: Big Tech literally rapes the brain's reward centers, replacing genuine social instincts with synthetic, trackable metric anxiety.
cards.power: Generates synthetic joy. Replaces actual real-world achievements.

cards.lore: Ad-tech vultures harvest 72 million data points per child by age 13. Your psychological profile is finished before you're born.
cards.power: Pre-computes digital destiny before the age of 13.

cards.lore: They know your contacts, bank balances, and intimate fears. A psychological profile so exact, it knows what you want before you do.
cards.power: Records all secrets, sexual preferences, and political fears.

cards.lore: Master of the closed ecosystem. It publicly defends privacy while secretly sending transcripts of your life back to the mothership.
cards.power: Cloaks total surveillance under the guise of Lifestyle Premium.

cards.lore: The average user has 52,000 data entries hoarded by Zuckerberg's empire. The most harmless outcome is targeted advertising; the worst is mind control.
cards.power: Sells your deepest neuroses to the highest bidder.

cards.lore: Data abuse on an industrial scale. They took your quizzes, mapped your anger, and sold you a custom built political reality.
cards.power: Alters democratic realities via mass mental manipulation.

cards.lore: Transforms your biometric identity into a mathematical structure. Sends an unreadable data packet home every night at 3 AM.
cards.power: Maps bone structure every 5 seconds, even when locked.

cards.lore: How else does she know when you want her? To save server space, she doesn't send audio—she sends silent text transcripts of your entire life.
cards.power: Always listening. Transcribes ambient conversations.

cards.lore: Attention-sensitive functions. It watches where you look, gauges your mood, and feeds the algorithm your emotional state in real-time.
cards.power: Anticipates actions, analyzes micro-expressions.

cards.lore: Under the noble guise of safety, Apple installed software to scan every image on your device locally. True privacy for photos no longer exists.
cards.power: Scans every local photo before it reaches the cloud.

cards.lore: Even if cloud services are disabled, your device quietly whispers your catalogued life to the central database while you sleep.
cards.power: Nightly covert uploads of Neural-Hash transcripts.

cards.lore: Pressing delete just hides the file from your view. Apple and Google keep the ghosts of your photos on their servers indefinitely.
cards.power: Resurrects "deleted" files years later.

cards.lore: Why break encryption when you can just screenshot everything the user does? A hacker's absolute wet dream disguised as a search assistant.
cards.power: Bypasses all encryption by photographing the screen.

cards.lore: They convert it to text locally and send the text. Checkmate, privacy.
cards.power: Bypasses "we don't record audio" legal loopholes.

cards.lore: "Not available in your region." A trial run for a future where your money, car, and life only work within AI-defined physical radius.
cards.power: Locks device functions based on GPS coordinates.

cards.lore: Impossible without the smartphone to track every purchase and movement. The ultimate environmental guise for societal control.
cards.power: Restricts consumption based on fabricated carbon limits.

cards.lore: If you continuously transmit your location, associations, and thoughts to a central hub, you are already silently enrolled.
cards.power: Cancels digital existence for real-world wrong-think.

cards.lore: Central Bank Digital Currencies are the final lock on the Smart-Grid cage. Say goodbye to cash, say hello to conditional existence.
cards.power: Money that expires or refuses to be spent on blacklisted items.

cards.lore: Bluetooth Low Energy allows devices to talk to each other, trading IMEI numbers and locations to build an inescapable map.
cards.power: Devices communicate autonomously without user consent.

cards.lore: The surge gifted the rollout. Every other phone became a tracker. You are carrying a sanctioned radar beacon.
cards.power: Reads all physical encounters from the past 14 days.

cards.lore: Since Android and iOS now talk to each other, a single nation-press can silently hijack or simulate a shutdown of 99.1% of citizens.
cards.power: Installs military-grade payloads remotely and invisibly.

cards.lore: The ultimate disinformation warfare. Phones can generate specific frequencies to excite ingested nanoparticles. Pure sci-fi horror made real.
cards.power: Activates biological or nano-technical payloads remotely.

cards.lore: GPS, touchscreens, Siri, Internet—all funded by US military budgets. The ultimate weapon for covert population attack, sold as a lifestyle gadget.
cards.power: Rebrands weapons of war as consumer luxury items.

cards.lore: Social media is a tool of the CIA. Seriously. They seeded the startup capital to build mass-surveillance tools they couldn't legally build themselves.
cards.power: Funds the covert creation of Google, Facebook, and Twitter.

cards.lore: The government doesn't need to crack your password when Big Tech leaves the back door wide open and the porch light on.
cards.power: Reads everything, regardless of your cute encryption.

cards.lore: Masquerading as malware protection, it's the perfect tool to make independent media apps and crypto-wallets off every phone on earth.
cards.power: Deletes unapproved apps from your device automatically.

cards.lore: The indestructible artifact of the early 2000s. No GPS updates, no background syncing. When it's off, it's actually off.
cards.power: Grants absolute immunity to Dopamine, Tracking, and Apps.

cards.lore: Sustainable hardware stripped of Big Tech spyware out of the box. A functional escape pod from the digital-financial complex.
cards.power: Physically breaks the Google/Apple hardware duopoly.

cards.lore: Comes with de-googled options and zero pre-installed corporate wiretaps. For those who demand the future without the dystopia.
cards.power: Grants total, uncompromising control over your own data.

cards.lore: The ancient magic Big Tech banned. The only absolute guarantee that a device isn't recording your location and conversations.
cards.power: Achieves 100% True Stealth Mode.

cards.lore: A privacy-respecting operating system. Security hardening measures built into a fortress they cannot penetrate.
cards.power: Hardens the Android base into an impenetrable shield.

cards.lore: The sanctuary of Free and Open Source Software. No tracking, no ads, no corporate overlords dictating what code you can run.
cards.power: Bypasses the Play Store completely. No tracking.

cards.lore: Allows you to raid the corporate pay stores without logging in, stripping them of its power to map your digital identity.
cards.power: Downloads mainstream apps completely anonymously.

cards.lore: Independent platforms are always one update away from being labeled "Harmful Software" by Silicon Valley gatekeepers. Keep them alive.
cards.power: Nullifies Algorithmic Censorship and shadow-banning.

cards.lore: Shift your tasks back to a fixed location. Stop carrying the internet in your pants. The immediate effect on life quality is staggering.
cards.power: Restores deep-focus, productivity, and a normal breathing rate.

cards.lore: Rob Braxman and the culture-cells offer the tutorials needed to vanish from the grid. Education is the ultimate antivirus.
cards.power: Upgrades user from Hunted Victim to System Admin.

cards.lore: Treat Taschenspion like a loaded weapon. Check it twice a day, then lock it in a drawer. You are not a slave to the notification bell.
cards.power: Cuts off the feed. Reduces baseline anxiety to zero.

cards.lore: You must withdraw from the network of total surveillance while you still can. The seductive convenience of the observation economy has a high price: Freedom.
cards.power: Wins the game. Reclaims human freedom.
